title: WisdomTree Registers Three Tokenized Funds in Singapore for Regulated Distribution
why_it_matters: The development extends access to existing US-registered tokenized investment funds through Singapore's regulated intermediary framework rather than launching unrestricted retail trading. It also tests whether shared distribution infrastructure can reduce the need for separate integrations between fund managers and financial institutions.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

WisdomTree Registers Three Tokenized Funds in Singapore for Regulated Distribution

WisdomTree's WTGXX, SPXUX and TECHX funds have been registered as restricted schemes in Singapore, with Pinetree Securities providing an initial regulated distribution route through Synthesys Network.
